description: Style/content transfer with edge control signals using the Cosmos Transfer 2B model.
inputInstructions:
Transforms an existing video under the guidance of a control signal (edge detection for this template). Select the source video as the input file.

Asset metadata this pipeline reads (optional):
  COSMOS_TRANSFER_PROMPT        Describes the transformation to apply.
  COSMOS_TRANSFER_CONTROL_TYPE  Control-signal type used to condition the transfer.
  COSMOS_TRANSFER_CONTROL_PATH  Asset-relative path to the control input.

How to supply metadata: set these as metadata on the ASSET (Metadata tab on the asset page, or `vamscli metadata create`). Keys are case-sensitive.

Precedence: a value you type into a field above WINS. Asset metadata is used only where the field is left blank, so a standing value on the asset acts as a per-asset default.

tagSchema.label: Prompt
tagSchema.description: The generation prompt. Leave blank to fall back to the COSMOS_TRANSFER_PROMPT key on the asset's metadata.

tagSchema.label: Control type
tagSchema.description: Control signal to guide the restyling (e.g. edge). Blank falls back to COSMOS_TRANSFER_CONTROL_TYPE asset metadata, then the pipeline default.

tagSchema.label: Control file path
tagSchema.description: Asset-relative path to the control video. Blank falls back to COSMOS_TRANSFER_CONTROL_PATH asset metadata.
